title: AutoBCI: Forecast-Guided Agentic Neural Architecture Discovery for EEG-Based Brain-Computer Interfaces
abstract: arXiv:2609.35456v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: EEG-based brain-computer interfaces support a broad range of applications, yet designing decoding architectures that perform well across diverse tasks remains challenging. We introduce AutoBCI, an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent and a Forecaster Agent support the discovery and selection of EEG decoding architectures across tasks. The Designer Agent performs Pool-Guided Architecture Discovery (PGAD), generating and refining architectures through training and validation across multiple EEG tasks, such as emotion recognition, motor imagery, and sleep staging. The Forecaster Agent performs Performance Estimation from Early Knowledge (PEEK), using architecture code, the training protocol, and early learning curves to predict full-budget validation performance and select promising candidates for continued training. translated_title: AutoBCI：面向基于EEG脑机接口的预测引导式智能体神经架构发现
translated_abstract: 基于EEG的脑机接口支持广泛的应用，然而设计在多样化任务中均能表现良好的解码架构仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了AutoBCI，这是一个智能体框架，由设计者智能体和预测者智能体协同支持跨任务的EEG解码架构的发现与选择。设计者智能体执行池引导架构发现（PGAD），通过在多个EEG任务（如情绪识别、运动想象和睡眠分期）上进行训练和验证来生成并改进架构。预测者智能体执行基于早期知识的性能估计（PEEK），利用架构代码、训练协议和早期学习曲线来预测全预算下的验证性能，并选出有前景的候选架构进行后续训练。在涵盖运动想象、情绪识别和睡眠分期的14个EEG数据集上，我们评估了AutoBCI……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: AutoBCI通过设计者智能体自动生成并改进EEG解码架构，同时由预测者智能体根据早期学习曲线预测架构的最终性能以筛选优秀候选，从而在情绪识别、运动想象和睡眠分期等14个EEG数据集上实现高效的脑机接口神经架构自动发现。
en_tdlr: AutoBCI is an agentic framework in which a Designer Agent automatically discovers and refines EEG decoding architectures while a Forecaster Agent predicts full-budget performance from early learning curves, enabling efficient architecture selection across 14 EEG datasets covering motor imagery, emotion recognition, and sleep staging.
